data.name: Jayanta
data.gender_notes: Jayanta is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jayanta is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'jay' meaning victory or triumph. It is a name for a brave and powerful individual, often associated with the gods Indra and Vishnu, who are known for their conquests and victories. The name Jayanta carries the meaning “Victorious, Conqueror” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jayanta usually hope their child will grow to embody victorious, conqueror and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: May your life be filled with victories and triumphs.
data.etymology: Jayanta belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victorious, Conqueror.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jayanta total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_sanskrit.name: जयान्त
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: जय (jaya) - victory, अन्त (anta) - end, स्वरूप (svarupa) - essence. So, Jayanta means one who is the embodiment of victory or invincible.

in_hindi.name: जयान्त
in_hindi.meaning: जय (jaya) - विजयी (vijayi) - विकत्म (vikatm) - विजयी शक्तिवान (vijayi shaktivan) - विजयी पुरुष (vijayi purush) - victorious, triumphant, invincible, powerful, heroic man.
in_hindi.long_meaning: जय (jaya) - विजयी (vijayi) - विकत्म (vikatm) - विजयी शक्तिवान (vijayi shaktivan) - विजयी पुरुष (vijayi purush) - विजयी (vijayi) - शक्तिवान (shaktivan) - शक्ति (shakti) - power, पुरुष (purush) - man. data.cultural_impact: The name Jayanta is rich in Indian cultural heritage. It evokes a sense of courage, strength, and triumph, qualities that are deeply valued in Hindu mythology and society. The name is reminiscent of great kings and warriors, who have played a significant role in shaping Indian history and culture. Jayanta is a name that inspires one to strive for success and victory, both in personal and professional pursuits.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Jayanta has deep roots in Hinduism. It is said that the name resonates with the divine energies of the gods Indra and Vishnu, who are believed to bestow victory and triumph upon their devotees. The name is also associated with the concept of 'jay' or spiritual victory, which refers to the victories that come from within, such as overcoming negative emotions and achieving inner peace and enlightenment. The name Jayanta serves as a constant reminder of the divine energies that are always present within us, and the power we have to overcome challenges and achieve our goals with grace and dignity.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Jayanta symbolizes victory and triumph over challenges. It is a reminder of the inner strength and power that propels one forward in life. The syllables 'Jaya' (victory) and 'anta' (end) suggest the end of suffering and the beginning of eternal joy.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Jayanta was a famous mathematician and astronomer during the Gupta Empire. The name Jayanta carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Jayanta is best known for his works in mathematics and astronomy.
